headline: On October 9, 1941: Ricardo Adolfo de la Guardia becomes Panama's president
captionCards: Panama borders Costa Rica, Colombia, Caribbean Sea, Pacific Ocean
instagramCaption:
Who took power in Panama during a pivotal 1941 coup?

A political coup declared Ricardo Adolfo de la Guardia Arango the new president of Panama. This nation sits at the southern end of Central America, bordering Costa Rica and Colombia. Its capital, Panama City, houses nearly half of the country's over 4 million inhabitants.

This leadership change shaped the modern Republic of Panama.
